notes.title: Exploding Babies EXPLODES out of early access!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997912/dec7a139ac730f06acbabe8fc1ff780ce2b14eb7.jpg[/img]
[h3]Are you ready for some EXPLOSIVE news?!?!!![/h3]

[h2]Exploding Babies is coming out of Early Access just before Halloween on 27.10.2021.[/h2]

[h3]BOOM![/h3]

We’ve upgraded the UI, polished the gameplay, added game modes and new baby characters. We’ve also made the soundtrack to the game available as a separate purchase, so be sure to check it out! Nothing cooler than to blast your own unofficial remix of the theme song in some illegal rave under a bridge, while the neon lights sweep across the autumn rain… it’s.. uplifting…

We’ve also streamlined a lot of the back-end stuff to make it easier to add even more gameplay in the future, so as long as you keep buying the game, we’ll keep adding new stuff to it! Hehee!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997912/50f0bc8f5bd88d0d5b493f916d1d88c94276c2c6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Oh hi there! How about a holiday update?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997912/4f72214c3cd4af6a2d3b6023c64de8a90d325af6.png[/img]
[h1]Long time no explode! [/h1]

As you probably know, we've been hard at work on our other game, Children of the Eclipse, and sadly Exploding Babies has been left in a hot car with no A/C on for FAR to long without any attention or nutrients. 

[h3]But DON'T WORRY! We're here to take care of the situation.[/h3]

We've been preparing something excellent for you guys. A holiday update is in the works, prepped for release THIS FRIDAY. We've got all sorts of cool stuff coming your way. Here's a few:

[h2]GRAPHICS OVERHAUL![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34997912/ea79eca13d963b7e0835c2454773e5d783f0dba8.jpg[/img]
We wanted to make the game JUST a bit less dark, but still appropriately twisted, so we went for a more cartoony look. We're also hoping to release the game on Switch, so a clearer image will help make sense of the action even on a smaller screen. 

[h2]NEW BABY - ?[/h2]
Yes - the new baby will be very holiday seasony.

[h2]NEW GAME MODE - TEAM DEATHMATCH[/h2]
Like regular deathmatch, but now split into two teams for more coordinated (you wish) exploding!

[h2]A BUNCH OF TWEAKS![/h2]
An impressive pile of bug fixes, tweaks to game modes and maps, better CPU AI for single player goodness etc etc...

[h2]UPDATE DISCOUNT![/h2]
We're planning to kick off the launch of the update with a discount, so now is the perfect time to get the game, or if you already have it, tell your friends to get it too!

Wishlist the game and/or follow us on Steam or social media to get the latest news!

notes.title: Game Modes Overview
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997912/dc23dc4f116e363bb65a986bc69b56d4bdb6e241.png[/img]

Time to lift the veil and talk about different game modes we have planned for you. Take a look.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997912/cdf74c00a846d17fcac03e5f652bf5b270b28de4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Survival (Classic) Mode[/h1]

The classic Exploding Babies experience. Use NPC drones to explode your friends - last baby standing wins the round. Beware of gameplay modifiers after the timer runs out!


[h1]Deathmatch[/h1]

Remember when you were a baby and your parents didn't let you play Doom multiplayer? This is what you missed.

Classic PvP gameplay, where you explode your friends and they spawn right back in for more carnage. The number of babies exploded determines the round winner. Play until the timer runs out, or until a set score is reached. 

[h1]Capture The Flag[/h1]

A baby must learn to TAKE, not give. A friendly (not really) game of Capture The Flag is the perfect tool for teaching this lesson. 

Work as a pair or on your own, steal other babies' flags and bring them to your base while trying to stop others from doing the same to you. It's a tough world out there.

[h1]BabyPong[/h1]

Before the apocalypse, this game was played with simple rectangles. Our Alien Masters ran out of rectangles, so they started using babies.

Babies are divided into two teams with their own unique safe spaces where the other babies can't intrude. Players score points by blasting the spawning drone babies to the other safe space's back wall, where Advanced Alien Technology(tm) takes care of the drone babies' quick and painless recycling.


[h1]
BabyRoyale[/h1]

The only thing that apparently survived the apocalypse was this immortal game of unimaginative electric storms and shrinking circles. 

Control up to 25 babies SIMULTANEOUSLY, blast EVERYTHING and be the last baby standing (lol, babies don't stand!)! When you win, you will be declared the Most Elite Survivalist Adventurer Meaningless Item Collector Baby - something you never thought you'd want to be declared as!

[h1]”King of the Hill"[/h1]

Another classic from the real-life playgrounds. To survive the apocalypse, babies must learn to love violent physical contact. Also, it's cool to be called The King of something.

The arena has a small scoring area. Be the only baby to stay inside the area to start scoring points. Once a set score is reached or the timer runs out, the baby with the highest score wins.

As you can see, this is a carnage like no other. Stay tuned, exciting news coming soon.

- Team Nutfarm Games

notes.title: Nutfarm News + WTF is Exploding Babies!?
notes.content:
[b]Hello, people![/b] (I'm sure there's someone out there, and I'm not just screaming into the void.)

[h1]Nutflash - the short stuff[/h1]

So, quick news first. We set the official release date for Exploding Babies Early Access at August 15th! Coolio!

Also, TRAILER RELEASED!

Maybe you already noticed, since it's up on steam as well, but here's the YouTube link just in case: 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BTOp_lLcW9w]Exploding Babies Early Access Announcement Trailer[/url]
Go check it out, subscribe etc.. for other Nutfarm-related videos. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997912/3d37118c314c307f80be969be7b154524c7903e6.jpg[/img]
[h1]WTF is Exploding Babies?![/h1]

Yes, indeed. In the last post I kind of explained the history of Exploding Babies. Now that we have an Early Access launch date set (I'll explain more about the planned feature set for release in the next post), maybe it's a good thing to quickly go over the basics of the game.

Exploding Babies is a local co-op party game with classic "easy to learn, hard to master" gameplay. The focus is on quick matches in a variety of messed-up environments, with changing themes and customisable game modes to keep things interesting. The aim is to have a BUNCH of these game modes, ranging from traditional ones like Deathmatch or Capture The Flag to more cryptic ones, like Sleep-a-Baby, Baby Pong and Boss Baby. Some game modes will be PvP, others will be PvE, some will feature teamplay, others will not. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997912/743a54f16672e2ce22235d19c324e824015fd1d2.jpg[/img]
[b]In all of the game modes, the simple control scheme remains the same - you move around with directional controls and blast a pressure wave with ANY button. The blast radius and force grows as you keep the button pressed. [/b]

A big part of the fun will be The Tournament - you can set the game modes and maps to play on, the amount of matches, the amount of rounds in a match and the winning conditions for a round (where applicable) and track the success (and failure!) of you and your friends over a whole night of intense baby exploding action.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34997912/976fad472d3a65f8a08996982f2eda3f488f6740.jpg[/img]
The core gameplay mechanics are already implemented and we're now in the process of designing the game modes and maps for the initial Early Access release. There will be plenty to choose from at the beginning, with more content added steadily as we get nearer to final release. We will communicate on the exact amount and type of content in a later post.

Allright! I think it's now time to activate Steam Summer Sale Hoarding Mode, so have fun and start pumping those baby exploding muscles of yours, they will be put to the test SOON!

Ari / Nutfarm
